-- Red Line Café (2019) - Urban café speculative design
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'urban café, industrial design, speculative design, gathering space, independent project'
WHERE title = 'Red Line Café';

-- Scenic Models (2024) - Collection of scale models
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scale models, theatrical models, scenic design, craftsmanship, model making'
WHERE title = 'Scenic Models';

-- Add display tags
INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (name, slug) VALUES 
  ('Urban Design', 'urban-design'),
  ('Industrial Aesthetic', 'industrial-aesthetic'),
  ('Speculative Design', 'speculative-design'),
  ('Independent Project', 'independent-project'),
  ('Scale Models', 'scale-models'),
  ('Model Making', 'model-making'),
  ('Craftsmanship', 'craftsmanship'),
  ('2019', '2019');

-- Link tags to Red Line Café
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p, tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Red Line Café'
  AND t.slug IN ('urban-design', 'industrial-aesthetic', 'speculative-design', 'independent-project', '2019')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM projectTags pt 
    WHERE pt.projectId = p.id AND pt.tagId = t.id
  );

-- Link tags to Scenic Models
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p, tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Scenic Models'
  AND t.slug IN ('scale-models', 'model-making', 'craftsmanship', '2024')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM projectTags pt 
    WHERE pt.projectId = p.id AND pt.tagId = t.id
  );
